title: Minimum Removals for Valid Parentheses
description: Given a string containing lowercase letters and parentheses, remove the fewest parentheses so the remaining parentheses are balanced. When scanning left to right, discard a closing parenthesis that has no unmatched opening parenthesis. If openings remain at the end, discard the rightmost such openings. Preserve all other characters. Input: `s`. Output: the resulting string.
constraints: s contains lowercase English letters and '(' or ')'
hints: Keep track of the smallest state needed to continue matching or comparing characters.
Test empty, one-character, repeated-character, and boundary inputs.
